headline: Japan Core Consumer Inflation Accelerates to 2.2% in October
summary: Japan's core consumer inflation accelerated to 2.2% year-on-year in October, while headline CPI rose to 2.3% from 2.1% in September, driven by higher energy prices.
why: Japan's CPI data influences the Bank of Japan's rate normalization trajectory and yen exchange rate valuation.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Higher inflation increases market expectations for monetary policy tightening by the Bank of Japan.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Accelerating core CPI data reinforced expectations of Bank of Japan policy adjustments.
